name: Sinomacrops
sum: Anurognathid from the Daohugou beds of Hebei, China — one of the best-known members of its family.
holotype: JPM-2012-001 — Daohugou beds (Tiaojishan Formation), Mutoudeng, Qinglong, Hebei.
material: Crushed, almost complete skeleton (many bones as impressions).
exceptional: Soft tissue suggests the arm membrane extended to the lower leg.
biology: Very long lower legs (twice the femur); an insect-catching anurognathid.
author: Wei et al. 2021

species.name: Sinomacrops bondei
species.author: Wei et al. 2021
